about: A deal by a real dealer of the style bordet, lifted out of the live table's film by verktyg/lyft.py into the lens world of data/uppsattning.json (metres: x to the picture's right, y up with the felt at 0, z toward the player). The same fields as our own figure's moves: per frame R and L (the dealer's own right and left) with s shoulder, e elbow, w wrist and p the hand's 21 points in MediaPipe's order (null where the hand was not found), h the head's middle, g the point he looks at (null where the face was not found), card with its middle c, its long side l and its normal n. The card is seen only where it lies on the felt (seen true); before that c is the grip of the hand taken to hold it and l and n are null. One camera gives no depth: the shoulders are put 0.158 m behind the felt's edge (estimated), the arms are held to an upper arm of 0.3 m and a forearm of 0.26 m (assumed), and the hip is assumed. verktyg/lyft.py prov says how far such a lift lies from the truth on our own figure's film. a is the face per frame: the shapes our own figure has, by ARKit's names, as MediaPipe's Face Landmarker scores them, 0 to 1 (null where the face was not found); evened over a tenth of a second, the blinks left as they are. Left and right are the dealer's own. It is the expression that is carried, not the face's form. data/stil-*.json, face, says which shapes carry something on a face this small and which are flutter.
seat_note: seats are 1 to 7 from the picture's left, the dealer's right
hip_note: assumed: 0.47 m under the shoulders' middle; the hips are hidden behind the table
